problem:
Title: Existence of Minimal Uncountable Well-Ordered Set/Proof Without Using Choice

There exists a [[Definition:Minimal Uncountable Well-Ordered Set|minimal uncountable well-ordered set]].

That is, there exists an [[Definition:Uncountable Set|uncountable]] [[Definition:Well-Ordered Set|well-ordered set]] $\Omega$ with the [[Definition:Property|property]] that every [[Definition:Initial Segment|initial segment]] in $\Omega$ is [[Definition:Countable Set|countable]].
